howToCollect: Gu 가족센터 site on the national familynet.or.kr platform (한국건강가정진흥원), collected by scripts/collectors/familynet.js --center dobong. robots.txt (User-agent *) allows /center/…, Crawl-delay 10 → requests are sequential 10s apart, plain GET, no cookies or login. Center name/address: GET /center/index.do (div.direct h2, p.loc). List: GET /center/lay1/program/S295T322C451/recruitReceipt/list.do?rows=5&cpage=N&status=plan,ongoing (server-rendered HTML; 5 per page fixed, rows ignored; status plan=접수예정, ongoing=접수중; 접수마감 left out — not open for application and the closed list is mostly past programs). Each li.clearfix: title + seq from send('<seq>',…) in p.tit; 회차정보 "총 N회" → sessions ("단회기" → null, it is also used for year-long classes); 행사기간 → programStart/End; 접수기간 "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ~ …" → applyStart/End; 진행장소 text + comeWay.openModal('', 주소, 상세) → venue; div.state span.cN → statusText. url = …/recruitReceipt/view.do?seq=<seq>. Not collected: the view page is an empty shell filled by POST /recruitReceipt/getView.do (needs CSRF token + session cookie), so target, 정원, 회차 일시, 소개글 are null and ageTags is empty (no target text to derive from). No fee field exists on the platform. Venue: "공동육아나눔터 ○○점" in 상세 → that name; 상세 mentions the center or same road address as the center → center name; online → 상세 as written; other address → 상세 without floor prefix (or the whole 진행장소 text when 상세 is only a room). Facility address = 진행장소 text as written (longest variant). Scope by title only (no target field): category = leading [영역] or 영역_ (관계·돌봄·생활·상담·공동체 names); keep when the rest has a child word (자녀, 아동, 유아, 초등, ○학년, 공동육아나눔터 …) or a family word (가족, 패밀리, 부모, 양육) without adult/teen markers (1인가구, 한국어교육, 취업, 자조모임, 봉사단, 동아리, 청소년, 결혼이민자 …).
